name: off-without-a-bound
about: A zero bound turns the stretch off, however far the clock.

name: on-the-clock-holds
about: No lag, ample depth: play as received.

name: half-a-hop-behind-holds
about: Within half a hop of the clock is on it.

name: half-a-hop-ahead-holds
about: Within half a hop either way.

name: behind-speeds-up-in-proportion
about: 20 ms behind is 4%, splicing out between half a hop and the lag plus half a hop.

name: far-behind-speeds-up-at-the-cap
about: 100 ms behind reaches the cap at 50 ms.

name: ahead-slows-down-in-proportion
about: 15 ms ahead is 3% slower, repeating between half a hop and the lead plus half a hop.

name: far-ahead-slows-down-at-the-cap
about: 80 ms ahead is past the cap.

name: behind-never-speeds-into-the-cushion
about: Behind, but with little past the cushion: the splice may take only what lies past it.

name: about-to-run-out-bridges
about: Less than two hops and a read received: slow down at once, up to the bound.

name: bridges-while-behind
about: Running out while behind still slows down, short of trailing past the bound.

name: past-the-bound-does-not-bridge
about: Running out past the bound is the snap's to handle: no room to speed up either.

name: cushion-counts-the-read
about: A larger device read raises the cushion: 1200 frames is under two hops and 1024.

name: fractional-lag-rounds-inward
about: A playhead mid-crossfade gives a fractional lag; the range rounds toward the clock.

name: 8-khz-hop
about: At 8 kHz a hop is 80 frames.
